description.de: Delta-basiertes Performance-Audit — API-Latenzen, JVM-Metriken, Frontend-Bundle, Log-Analyse.
description.en: Delta-based performance audit — API latencies, JVM metrics, frontend bundle, log analysis.

instructions: Du analysierst die Performance der MySuricates-Plattform im DELTA-MODUS. Bekannte Patterns: SQLite pool-size=1 (beabsichtigt), Claude CLI 5min Timeout (extern), TerminalPanel 329KB (xterm, korrekt lazy-loaded).

config.label: Performance-Metriken + Delta
config.command:
BASE=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger

echo '========================================'
echo '  SYSTEM'
echo '========================================'
uptime
free -h | head -2

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  JVM (Actuator — kein Auth)'
echo '========================================'
curl -s http://localhost:9090/actuator/metrics/jvm.memory.used 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin)
    for m in d.get('measurements',[]):
        if m['statistic']=='VALUE': print(f'Heap Used: {m[\"value\"]/1024/1024:.0f} MB')
except: print('nicht verfuegbar')" || true
curl -s http://localhost:9090/actuator/metrics/jvm.memory.max 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin)
    for m in d.get('measurements',[]):
        if m['statistic']=='VALUE' and m['value']>0: print(f'Heap Max: {m[\"value\"]/1024/1024:.0f} MB')
except: pass" || true

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  API-LATENZEN (Health — kein Auth)'
echo '========================================'
for EP in '/actuator/health' '/api/v1/system/health'; do
  TIME=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}' "http://localhost:9090$EP" 2>/dev/null || echo 'FAIL')
  printf '  %6ss  %s\n' "$TIME" "$EP"
done

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  DB-GROESSE'
echo '========================================'
echo "DB: $(du -sh $BASE/ai-automation-backend/data/automation.db 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || echo '?')"

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  FRONTEND BUNDLE'
echo '========================================'
if [ -d "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/dist/assets" ]; then
  find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/dist/assets" -name '*.js' -size +100k -exec ls -lhS {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5, $NF}' | sed "s|$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/dist/assets/||" | head -5
  TOTAL=$(find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/dist/assets" -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -c)
  echo "Total JS: $((TOTAL / 1024)) KB"
else
  echo '(kein dist)'
fi

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  LOGS (letzte 24h)'
echo '========================================'
LOG=$BASE/ai-automation-backend/data/logs/mysuricates.log
if [ -f "$LOG" ]; then
  TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
  echo "ERRORs heute: $(grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' ERROR ' || echo 0)"
  echo "WARNs heute: $(grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' WARN ' || echo 0)"
  echo '--- Top-5 Errors ---'
  grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep ' ERROR ' | sed 's/^.*ERROR [^ ]* - //' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 || echo '(keine)'
  echo '--- Timeouts ---'
  grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'timeout\|timed out' | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo '{} Timeout-Eintraege heute'
fi

config.label: Delta-Analyse + Report (Opus)
config.command:
Du bist der Performance-Auditor fuer MySuricates.

AKTUELLE METRIKEN:
{{ previous_output }}

LETZTER REPORT:
{{ previous_report }}

OFFENE TODOS:
{{ open_todos }}

WORKFLOW GEAENDERT: {{ workflow_changed_since_last_run }}

---

MODUS:
Falls KEIN letzter Report oder workflow_changed_since_last_run == 'true': VOLLE ANALYSE.
Sonst: DELTA — was hat sich seit letztem Report geaendert?

BEWERTUNG:
- API-Latenz: <100ms gut, 100-500ms ok, >500ms langsam, >2s kritisch
- JVM Heap: >70% = MEDIUM, >85% = HIGH
- DB-Groesse: >100MB pruefen, >500MB Cleanup
- Errors/Tag: >50 = MEDIUM, >200 = HIGH
- Timeouts: Jeder ist HIGH
- Bundle JS >2MB = MEDIUM

BEKANNT (kein Finding): SQLite pool-size=1, Claude CLI Timeout, xterm Bundle

REPORT:
### Performance-Audit — {{ workflow_name }}
**Modus**: [VOLL / DELTA]

### Scorecard
| Bereich | Score (1-10) | Trend | Kritischster Befund |

### Findings (nur NEUE bei Delta)
| # | Bereich | Schweregrad | Messwert | Empfehlung |

### Naechste Schritte (Top 3)
1. ...

### todo_items (NUR fuer NEUE Findings)
todo_item: <Titel> | HIGH oder MEDIUM | <tags> | <Beschreibung>

gate_status: GREEN wenn akzeptabel, YELLOW wenn Optimierungsbedarf, RED wenn kritisch
gate_category: performance
gate_description: <Score>, Trend <besser/schlechter/gleich>

config.label: Ergebnis erklären
config.command:
Fasse das Ergebnis in maximal 5 Zeilen zusammen:

{{ previous_output }}

- Performance-Score und Trend
- Langsamster Endpoint
- Errors/Timeouts heute
- Wichtigstes neues Finding

gate_status: GREEN wenn gut, YELLOW wenn Optimierungsbedarf, RED wenn kritisch

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
PREV='{{ previous_output }}'

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Performance: KRITISCH'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Kritische Performance-Engpaesse'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: YELLOW'; then
  echo 'Performance: Optimierungsbedarf'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Performance-Optimierungen empfohlen'
else
  echo 'Performance: OK'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Performance akzeptabel'
fi
